name: Fly Story: Perspective Specialization Guide
description: Supplement to the main cognitive_framework.json, detailing how specific perspectives manifest in the Fly story. Shows transformation of perspectives in alchemical context of value inversion and geological time.

primary_explicit.name: paradoxní
primary_explicit.why_key: Central paradox of same reality being catastrophe and paradise simultaneously
manifestations: Pro bordeláře katastrofa, pro mouchu ráj
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer D (ENVIRONMENT) rather than base layer I (TIME) - paradox becomes the very environment

primary_explicit.name: absurdní
primary_explicit.why_key: Absurdity of finding abundance in decay, home in trouble
manifestations: Moucha v průseru jako v ráji
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer C (PHENOMENON) rather than base layer J (DISRUPTION) - absurdity becomes the phenomenon itself

primary_explicit.name: psychologický
primary_explicit.why_key: Psychological transformation of bordelářů from ignorance to awareness
primary_explicit.layer_transformation: Appears in layer I (TIME) rather than base layer E (STATE) - psychology becomes temporal (vrstvení rozhodnutí)

secondary_implicit.name: filozofický
secondary_implicit.why_key: Questions about value, time, identity, and the nature of paradise

secondary_implicit.name: meta
secondary_implicit.why_key: Story comments on perception, attention, and the nature of commentary itself
manifestations: Reflexe o tom, jak vzniká problém

secondary_implicit.name: paradoxní
secondary_implicit.why_key: Also secondary in geological time – vrstvení jako paradox (minulost přítomná ve skvrně)
manifestations: Skvrna není skvrna, je to geologie

tertiary_present.name: asociativní
tertiary_present.why_key: Free associations between moucha, moruše, skvrna, bzučení, čas

tertiary_present.name: kulturní
tertiary_present.why_key: Subversion of cultural disgust toward flies and mess

tertiary_present.name: ironický
tertiary_present.why_key: Irony that salvation comes from what is usually despised

layer_transformations_specific_to_fly.transformation_description: Paradox moves from temporal dimension to become the very environment. The paradox of value is not just temporal but spatial – it's the world they inhabit.
layer_transformations_specific_to_fly.story_evidence: Dvorek je zároveň katastrofa i ráj – paradox je prostředím, ne jen časovým rozporem

layer_transformations_specific_to_fly.transformation_description: Absurdity moves from being disruptive to becoming the phenomenon itself. What should disturb becomes the new normal, the observed reality.
layer_transformations_specific_to_fly.story_evidence: Pro mouchu je průser normální, je to její svět – absurdita se stala fenoménem

layer_transformations_specific_to_fly.transformation_description: Psychological states move from internal condition to become temporal layers. Emotions and decisions sediment into time.
layer_transformations_specific_to_fly.story_evidence: Odkládání, únava, rozhodnutí – to vše se ukládá jako geologické vrstvy

perspective_interactions_unique_to_fly.description: Tension between paradox (same reality opposite values) and absurdity (finding abundance in decay). Paradox provides structure, absurdity provides method.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_fly.manifestation: Paradox umožňuje, že průser je ráj; absurdita umožňuje, že v tom moucha vidí hojnost

perspective_interactions_unique_to_fly.description: Psychological awareness leads to philosophical questions. Jakmile uvidí problém, ptají se 'kdo jsme my?'.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_fly.manifestation: Z fuj se stává 'tohle jsme my' – psychologický posun k filozofické identitě

perspective_interactions_unique_to_fly.description: Meta-reflection on time reveals its paradoxical nature. Čas není lineární, ale vrstvený a paradoxně přítomný.
perspective_interactions_unique_to_fly.manifestation: Příběh o odkládání je sám o čase, který se vrství – meta a paradox se spojují

woman_relaxed.description: Relaxovaná žena uprostřed chaosu – absurdní (klid v průseru), paradoxní (stejné místo katastrofa i ráj), psychologický (její výraz)

flies.description: Mouchy – absurdní (jsou doma v průseru), filozofické (komentář), asociativní (spojení s rozkladem, životem)

text_placement.description: Text dole vpravo, zapletený – meta (komentář o komentáři), paradoxní (součást problému), absurdní (text v průseru)

water_lines.description: Vlnité čáry – paradoxní (klidná hladina, pod ní chaos), asociativní (spojení s plynutím času), filozofické (hloubka)

ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.i_paradoxical: Can AI hold two opposite valuations of same reality simultaneously? Can it see paradox as environment?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.j_absurd: Can AI accept that what is usually despised can be home? Can it see absurdity as phenomenon?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.e_psychological: Can AI track psychological transformation from ignorance to awareness? Can it see psychology as temporal layering?
ai_testing_focus_for_perspectives.layer_transformations: Can AI detect how perspectives shift layers in alchemical context?

with_cows.contrast: Cows: deconstruct language; Fly: deconstruct value

with_lemur.contrast: Lemur: paradox of being seen; Fly: paradox of valuing

with_butterfly.contrast: Butterfly: absurdity of literalized metaphor; Fly: absurdity of reframed value

with_donkey.contrast: Donkey: paradox of decision; Fly: paradox of perception

note: This guide supplements but does not replace cognitive_framework.json. It shows how the universal perspectives manifest specifically in the Fly story's context of alchemical value inversion and geological time.
